scope: Constrained point-fix entry for native inline PDF pages, applied to nemata-jp pages 309 and 315; no full-page reproduction, no self-issued approval of unlocated changes.

mechanism.pattern: Reuses the 79-cn exact-field correction pattern: page-scoped root acceptance + preserved production raw + parent candidate + failed audit + independent review of the revision SHA.
mechanism.codeCommit: de26cb1 Add bounded native inline field correction audit route
invariants: Every unlisted field of the revision must still equal the preserved production raw parsedOutput byte-for-byte.
Original production raw, parent candidate and failed audit are never modified; their SHAs are re-verified on every audit and every publication check.
Each approved change must be derivable from the raw value by unique exact replacements and must carry a bound source crop plus optional source text-block evidence.
Every failing item of the parent review must be addressed by at least one approved change, and no approved change may be unrelated to a failing item.
A fresh independent model review of the revision candidate is required; the old review is retained only as history and never counts as the pass for the new bytes.
Supplemental reviews of earlier revisions can add located defects only when their receipt SHA, revision SHA and change subset are bound and preserved.

rejectionCases: missed failing audit item -> audit_native_inline_correction_unresolved_audit_item (unit) and compiled/raw mismatch (real data)
structural failing item a field diff cannot resolve -> audit_native_inline_correction_structural_error
tests.realDataChecks: The same rejection set was re-run against the real 309 and 315 approval/proof/raw objects; all tampered variants were rejected.

changes: r17 transcription: arrows under 2m and the broken-image icon
r26 transcription and b38-b39 paragraph: 久人 -> ヒサト (original is katakana)
